verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and indexes a 515-page markdown docs bundle; its entries cover payment flows. The docs are also served as .md pages and include agent-targeted skill files (cdp-cli/skill.md, agentic-wallet skills with 'Use when…' triggers) written for agents to consume. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents use these docs effectively in practice.
